scope: Actual product-centered seed middle canonical source through three spatial derivatives; no full metric inverse or cold/outer source theorem.
strongest_comparator: The complete middle 1e22 estimate was withdrawn for mixing fixed-cap and moving-cap derivatives; the repaired complete bound was 1e26. Its fixed-cap gluing recurrence remains valid.
new_claim: A direct weighted cap resolvent row has constant 10 instead of the old 30000. A finite translation polynomial differentiates the same cap's UV term on radius 1/500. The combined canonical middle source C3 allowance is below 6e15 q^2 in unchanged j!100^j units.
hypothesis_audit: The actual product-centered polynomial meets the strict normal-chart, mass, angular and scale guards; no old metric-response inverse is transferred.
The plane cap row uses the exact resolvent identity, positive real mass and a weighted inverse, not a guessed actual global point kernel.
The diagonal free singularity is restricted away from the observation or multiplied by a mass difference vanishing there.
Both gluing commutators, both observation rows, the actual paired-domain inverse and the full angular sum remain.
The UV and gluing terms use the same fixed cap; the withdrawn moving-cap combination is not reused.
Complex translation is only a finite parameter polynomial matching real jets; the C4 cutoff is not treated as spatially analytic.
The larger translation disk uses the plane Born proof's mass-potential and inner-jet bounds, not an enlarged actual-domain Frechet theorem.
The independent Weyl/radius pieces, cold/outer regions, full physical graph inverse and nonlinear/domain transfer are outside the claim.

external_sources_read.use: Positive-real integral representations used to derive the K0 and K1 envelopes.
external_sources_read.limitation: Does not prove the curved cap or actual paired-domain estimates.

protocol.rational: Goursat seed jets, Bessel moment envelopes, weighted resolvent/row budgets, finite translation coefficient cone, angular and complete source budgets
protocol.numerical: Independent weighted Bessel moment integration and point envelope checks
